summary.timing_policy: stream_* uses complete wall time including validation, JSONL telemetry and drops while prefetched work advances; legacy scenes_per_second uses only capture spans and may overestimate delivery throughput. Preparation wall stages partition a task lifetime, overlap across rooms, and are not additive with capture wall time. update_phase_seconds classifies event-loop call time by the blocker observed before the call, not CPU/GPU execution. Render diagnostics can overlap and arrive late; not a per-scene GPU accounting partition. No PNG/dataset encoding unless save_samples; GPU utilization measured separately
